purpose: Source-backed nominal component references and explicit fit uncertainties; not an as-built scan or exact manufacturer assembly CAD.

board.identity: User-listed XYCJJCXL / Nextronics S2 Mini V1.0.0; geometry referenced to official WEMOS S2 mini V1.0.0 drawing and photos, not verified against the user's physical clone.
board.limits: No Gerbers, board layout, component BOM, or exact clone CAD supplied. Header grid, component placement, underside solder protrusion, antenna traces and corner/notch geometry are inferred. Do not certify fit from these meshes alone. Only the two mounting holes support the PCB; no support is assumed at the USB end.

board_photo_envelopes.status: Positions and heights below are approximate from official WEMOS photos, not manufacturer package/assembly CAD.

switch.limits: Independently modeled external fit features from the drawing. Clip, light-guide, stem-height and pin shapes contain approximations. Not a Gateron STEP model; spring/contact internals omitted.

keycap.part: MaxKeyboard Custom-Art-Keycap, OEM R3 1x1.5 Tab, white ABS
keycap.status: No exact vendor CAD or mechanical drawing found in product, profile, or download pages. Current 28x18x9 mm sculpted cap is an illustrative approximation, not verified against this SKU.
keycap.caution: Cap is an outer visual envelope, not a hollow manufacturer model. It overlaps internal switch reference geometry intentionally; no stem-fit claim is made.

case_screw.limits: Independent nominal envelope; threads and exact drive recess geometry not reproduced. Vendor STEP/OBJ available but not redistributed.

board_screw.limits: Independent nominal envelope; see BOM for exact selected source. Thread and drive recess details simplified.

inserts.status: Published manufacturer dimensions; independent envelopes omit knurl and exact threads. Verify CAD-to-print seat diameter with coupons.

feet.status: Specified cut-to-size rubber feet, with 1 mm corner radius matching the printed pockets.

wires.status: Pin mapping is verified from official pinout; insulation diameter, solder sizes and routed lengths are illustrative and must be checked after assembly.

usb_cable.status: Illustrative unmeasured cable/plug. These are clearance assumptions, not verified dimensions of the Adafruit cable listed in the BOM.

license_policy: No manufacturer CAD meshes or drawings embedded in the repository or Blender file. Models are independent nominal constructions with source links; dimensions do not establish permission to redistribute vendor CAD.
